title: Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21 Admission & Tour
includes: Access to all Museum's exhibitions, Guided tour, Museum Boutique, Scotiabank Family History Centre
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
More than a national museum and national historic site. Our interactive exhibitions have activities for all ages. Immerse yourself in our history and learn about the courage, hope, hardship, and resilience at the heart of immigrant experience. Located on the Halifax waterfront.

THINGS TO DO:

NEW: Welcome To Turtle Island: Indigenous art installation by Tribal Fusion Art (Dec 2025 - 2027)

STEP INTO THE PAST: Experience what it was like to immigrate to Canada through historic Pier 21 where nearly one million immigrants arrived here from 1928-1971 with an English or French guided tour.

DISCOVER OVER 400 YEARS OF HISTORY in the Canadian Immigration Story exhibition, incl. a 10-min film showcasing contributions from Canadian immigrants. 

UNCOVER YOUR FAMILY’S ROOTS at Scotiabank Family History Centre.

SHOP Canadian treasures at the Museum Boutique. 

Café on-site
